event.title: Severe Earthquake Strikes Kumamoto, Japan, Causing Casualties and Damage
event.canonical_title: Severe Earthquake Strikes Kumamoto, Japan, Causing Casualties and Damage
event.summary: A magnitude 6.8 to 7.1 earthquake struck Kumamoto on Japan's southern island of Kyushu, causing significant damage and injuring at least 50 people. Some individuals are reportedly trapped in a partially collapsed shopping mall, and power outages affected thousands of homes. Initial tsunami warnings were issued but later rescinded as no tsunami was detected.

timeline.summary: A strong earthquake has hit southern Japan, particularly affecting the town of Kashima, where a shopping mall partially collapsed. Many people are feared dead, and dozens have been hospitalized due to injuries. The earthquake also triggered a tsunami warning, leading to further concerns for the safety of residents.
